institution_name: PUC-Rio - Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro

coverage.notes: Reviewed the official 2027 undergraduate courses-and-credentials catalogue (Bachelor/Bacharelado and Licenciatura; course, admissions-group, credential, daytime/evening and duration filters, but no language-of-instruction filter), the four academic-centre pages and the international incoming English-course pages. Only English-taught individual disciplines for one or two exchange/visiting semesters were explicitly confirmed. No complete direct-first-year 2027 degree was verified as taught in English. The 2027 catalogue does not explicitly rule all such degrees out either, so neither 'listed' nor 'none' is established. Accordingly no programme is represented as verified English-taught. Contact degree admissions (CCAR), rather than the exchange office, to verify degree-medium and 2027 IB conditions. The 2027 applicant-manual PDF was not accessible for direct examination; programme-level admissions evidence remains incomplete.

institution.summary: Non-profit Catholic research university in Gávea, Rio de Janeiro; a 2027 IB admission route exists, but English-taught degrees are unverified.

faculties.name: Centro de Teologia e Ciências Humanas (CTCH)
faculties.guidance: Covers architecture, arts/design, letters, philosophy, pedagogy, psychology and theology. Use the 2027 university-wide course listing and admissions route; degree teaching language must be checked separately.

faculties.name: Centro de Ciências Sociais (CCS)
faculties.guidance: Covers administration, economics, law, history, geography, communication, international relations, social sciences and social work. Entry choices and examination groups are in the 2027 vestibular catalogue.

faculties.name: Centro Técnico Científico (CTC)
faculties.guidance: Covers technical and scientific departments. The 2027 competition routes engineering, physics, mathematics and chemistry through a basic cycle, with professional programme choice from the third semester; computer science and AI have separately named entry choices.

faculties.name: Centro de Ciências Biológicas e da Saúde (CCBS)
faculties.guidance: The centre lists undergraduate biology and nutrition. The 2027 entrance-exam group also includes pharmacy and neuroscience; language of each complete degree remains unverified.

claims.statement: The standard on-campus 2027 vestibular tests include written Portuguese/Brazilian Literature and an essay, and a foreign-language objective test; Group 1 requires English as that foreign-language subject. claims.statement: PUC-Rio’s 2027-admissions tuition page actually displays a 2026 first-semester MONTHLY fee table, not a 2027/28 fee schedule. Its listed standard undergraduate monthly first-term figures range from R$3,601 (Pharmacy) to R$6,869 (27-credit basic-cycle science); later-month amounts depend on registered credits.
